problem: Instagram publication passed all Mira media gates but failed in Composio identity preflight because the publisher still used a historical numeric Instagram Business/Graph User ID.
root_cause: The canonical social publisher treated a provider-issued numeric user ID as a permanent identity constant. The active canonical connection still represented bedrijfsgeheugen.nl but returned a different current Business user ID.
prevention: Bind canonical identity to username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl plus BUSINESS/CREATOR account type. Discover providerUserId live with INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO(me) on the selected active canonical connection before side effects, and use that same returned ID for create, publish and readback.
failed_approaches: Calling INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO with the historical hardcoded Graph ID.
Treating ACTIVE connection metadata alone as enough without provider identity readback.
